title: Petra

place.label: Petra, Ma'an Governorate, Jordan
place.basis: official UNESCO World Heritage point; not a boundary
place.coords_source: UNESCO World Heritage Centre official point for Petra (World Heritage List 326), published as N30 19 50.016 E35 26 35.988 at https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/326/maps/ (table read 2026-11-27); approximate, not a boundary

tiers.everyday: Petra in Jordan was the rock-cut capital of the Nabataeans, a trading people known for tombs and temples cut into sandstone.
tiers.student: UNESCO links Petra to the Nabataean civilization of the 4th century BC to the 1st century AD, notes the area was inhabited since prehistoric times, and describes it as a caravan centre in Hellenistic and Roman times. Pleiades calls it the Nabataean capital. Inscribed 1985.
